en: Fixed cloud sessions rejecting every subagent tool call ("updatedInput … failed schema validation") when a workflow or agent approval was applied after the session's worker restarted
zh: 修复了在 session 的 worker 重启后应用工作流或 agent 审批时，云 session 拒绝所有 subagent 工具调用（"updatedInput … failed schema validation"）的问题
